content.title: What Time Does 'The Pitt' Season 2 Finale Come Out?
content.text: Published April 16, 2026, 9:00 a.m. ET The Pitt Season 2 - Trailer0 seconds of 2 minutes, 7 secondsVolume 0% The Pitt Season 2 has literally pushed Dr. Michael “Robby” Robinavitch (Noah Wyle) to the end of his limit. In last week’s all-new episode of the HBO Max hit, Robby actually admitted to his friend Duke (Jeff Kober) that he doesn’t know if he wants to “be here anymore.” According to the tortured physician, he can only live inside the ED because he has a purpose there. Nevertheless, he doesn’t know if he wants to be “anywhere anymore.” Meaning, his sabbatical might indeed be a final ride for the beloved doctor. The Pitt Season 2 takes place about nine months after the events of the first season and it seems that Dr. Robby is far from recovering from the trauma of that day. Whitaker (Gerran Howell) helped Robby get off the floor in pedes last season, but can anyone get through to the doctor this season? So far, Dana (Katherine LaNasa), McKay (Fiona Dourif), Jeffersion (Christopher Thornton), and Duke have all tried get through to the physician, but it’s unclear if Robby will persist in his plan to ride towards death or if he will seek the help he needs. How will The Pitt Season 2 end? Here’s everything you need to know to watch The Pitt Season 2 Episode 15 “9 PM” on HBO Max… Photo: HBO Max When Does The Pitt Season 2 Finale Come Out? The Pitt Season 2 Episode 15 “9 PM” Release Date: The Pitt Season 2 Episode 15 “9 PM” will premiere on HBO MAX on Thursday, April 2. Most new episodes of HBO MAX originals hit the streaming service at 9 PM ET/6 PM PT. Photo: HBO Max How Many Episodes Are in The Pitt? The Pitt Season 2 Episode Guide: There are fifteen episodes in The Pitt Season 2, which means that tonight is the last new episode of The Pitt until Season 3 comes out in 2027. Have no fear, The Pitt is coming back next year! HBO Max has already renewed The Pitt for a third season. The Pitt Season 3 should come out in January 2027. Is There a Trailer for The Pitt Season 2? Yup! You can watch The Pitt Season 2 trailer by scrolling to the top of this page. The Pitt Season 2 Cast Guide: HBO Max’s The Pitt features a massive ensemble cast of actors, some of whom you might already know from projects like The Librarians, Big Love, The L Word, Animal Kingdom, Catch-22, American Vandal, Shrinking, or Star Trek: Picard.
